A.scope: Main-thread selected mod root union from one tickServer start to the next, including main-thread roots outside tickServer. Zero-work cycles count zero. A fixed live snapshot has one fewer completed cycle than completed tick frames; the current incomplete cycle is excluded. Stop seals at the next tick start, flushes the final complete cycle, and excludes that new tick frame; sealed cycles must equal tick frames. No raw cross-JVM clock subtraction and no claim of uninstrumented mod work or CPU time.
A.coverage_limits: Explicit whitelist only. Includes actual TesseractBlockEntity.saveAdditional and selected compat.changed/AE insert-extract-inventory/GT energy mutation/Mek chemical-heat mutation entries. Uninstrumented GUI, other save/load hooks, other compat callbacks/getters, method prefixes/suffixes, and outside-tick work are excluded from the per-tick sum. Optional compat hooks with no actual calls remain unexercised; transformed_classes records actual loaded descriptors.
